# Daily Report — 2026-10-27

## Task Completed
Added sys_choice tools (`list_field_choices`, `create_field_choice`) for picklist management
via the `sys_choice` table. `list_field_choices` supports filtering by table_name, field_name,
language, and include_inactive; results are ordered by sequence with has_more/next_offset pagination.
`create_field_choice` POSTs a new choice with value, label, sequence, language, hint, inactive, and
dependent_value fields. Both tools registered in system_administrator and full packages.
